## Rubric for Mathematics Corner Activity

| Criteria | 5 pts (Level 5) | 3 pts (Level 3) | 1 pt (Level 1) |
|------------------|------------------|------------------|------------------|
| **ENGAGE** | All of level 3 AND: Predicts students' questions and plans for individual learning needs. | All of level 1 AND: Uses students' background knowledge and interest to motivate the task with real-life examples. | Uses some strategies to uncover student thinking but makes minimal connections to prior knowledge. |
| **EXPLORE** | All of level 3 AND: Offers open-ended tasks with multiple solution paths; students prepare evidence and contribute to discussions. | All of level 1 AND: Allows hands-on exploration and student decision-making; supports collaboration with multiple strategies and questions. | Task is one-dimensional with no variety; teacher fully prescribes steps; little support for engagement. |

**Total Points: 10**
